column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each RGB lighting record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Mechanical(MechRegistry), associating RGB details with a mechanical record (e.g., a keyboard).
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing AudioAndMedia(AudRegistry), linking RGB details to audio/media data if necessary.
A SMALLINT indicating the RGB brightness level (on a predefined scale or percentage).
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring color accuracy or uniformity (e.g., Delta E or similar scale).
A SMALLINT specifying the refresh rate (in Hz) at which the RGB lighting updates.
A VARCHAR(25) naming the different RGB lighting modes (e.g., 'Wave', 'Static', 'Breathing').
A SMALLINT counting how many independent zones or sections of RGB control the device has.
An INTEGER for the total number of distinct colors supported (e.g., 16.8 million).
